basic_details.job_title: DPCC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 59 Legal Assistant, Scientific Assistant & More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC), Department of Environment, Government of NCT of Delhi, has issued a rolling advertisement for 59 posts on deputation, including short-term contract, open only to officers holding a regular post in the Central or State Government, a Union Territory, a recognised research institute, an autonomous or statutory body, or a PSU. Candidates must be no older than 56 on the closing date of the phase they apply in. Officers working in private organisations, on contract, retired or unemployed are not considered.

important_dates.age reckoned as on: Closing date of the phase in which the application is received

qualification.details: "Analogous post" means the same post held on a regular basis in the parent organisation. Where the circular names a pay level, the years of regular service must be in that level or its equivalent. "Related field of engineering" for the engineering posts means Civil, Environment, Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, ECE, Biomedical Engineering, Water Resources, Remote Sensing, GIS or Hydrology.

selection_process: The circular does not set out a written test or a scoring scheme. It refers to candidates being called for interview
and the NOC requirement for advance-copy applicants is specifically for "appearing in interview". DPCC reserves the right not to fill any post
and the number of posts may change. Selection details will be posted on the DPCC website from time to time.
how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through proper channel, in the prescribed proforma, in English or Hindi.
Download the advertisement and the application form from dpcc.delhigovt.nic.in under "Office Order & Circulars".

Fill in the proforma: post applied for, personal and department details, date of retirement, education, a point-by-point statement of how you meet each essential and desirable requirement, employment history with pay level of the post held on a regular basis (enclose your latest salary slip), nature of present employment, feeder-grade status, total emoluments, and supporting information such as publications, awards and professional affiliations. Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration.
Attach self-attested copies of proof of age, educational qualifications, work experience, and SC/ST/OBC/PwD certificate if claiming.

Have your employer or cadre-controlling authority complete the certification on the last page: that the particulars are correct, you hold the qualifications and experience, you will be relieved if selected, no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending, integrity is certified, the CR dossier or attested ACR/APAR copies for the last five years are enclosed, and whether any major or minor penalty was imposed in the last ten years.

Your department forwards the application with the signed bio-data, attested APAR copies for five years, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance and penalty statement to: The Administrative Officer, Delhi Pollution Control Committee, 3rd Floor, IT Park, DMRC Building, Shastri Park, Delhi – 110053
Write the name of the post on the envelope.

If your department's forwarding may be delayed, you may send an advance copy. In that case you must produce a No Objection Certificate from your department to appear for the interview, with an undertaking to submit all requisite documents before joining. An advance copy does not replace the proper-channel application.
Applications that are incomplete, not through proper channel, or without attested APAR copies are not considered; there is no second chance within the phase.
If you already applied to DPCC's earlier rolling advertisement with complete documents, you do not need to apply again.
Each post has two independent conditions (service and qualification). Check both before asking your department to forward the application, since candidature cannot be withdrawn later.
No correspondence or representation is entertained about interview calls or selection.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Eligibility
content_sections.text: "Analogous post" means the same post held on a regular basis in the parent organisation. Where the circular names a pay level, the years of regular service must be in that level or its equivalent. "Related field of engineering" for the engineering posts means Civil, Environment, Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, ECE, Biomedical Engineering, Water Resources, Remote Sensing, GIS or Hydrology. Senior Environmental Engineer (Level 12, 8 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 11; and a Master's degree in engineering in a related field with ten years' experience in pollution control or a related field after the Master's. Environmental Engineer (Level 11, 15 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 10; and either a Bachelor's degree in engineering in a related field with eight years' experience in pollution control after the degree, or a Master's degree in engineering in a related field with six years' experience after the Master's. Assistant Environmental Engineer (Level 10, 15 posts): analogous post in Level 10 on a regular basis; and a degree in engineering in a related field with two years' experience in pollution control or a related field, or a Master's degree in engineering. Additional Director (Scientific) (Level 13, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 12; and a Master's degree in science with fifteen years' experience in pollution control or related subjects, or a doctorate in science with ten years' experience. Senior Scientist L-II / Scientist-D (Level 12, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 11; and a Master's degree in science with thirteen years' experience in pollution control or related subjects, or a doctorate in science. Senior Scientist L-I / Scientist-C (Level 11, 2 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 10; and a Master's degree in science with eight years' experience in pollution control or related subjects. Scientist-B (Level 10, 1 post): analogous post, or eight years' regular service in analogous posts in Level 6; and a Master's degree in science with three years' experience in pollution control or related subjects. Scientific Assistant (Level 6, 4 posts): analogous post, or ten years' regular service in Level 4; and a Bachelor's degree in science with experience in laboratory work. Senior Lab Assistant (Level 4, 5 posts): analogous post, or eight years' regular service in Level 2. The circular sets no separate educational qualification for this post. Assistant Law Officer (Level 7, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 6; and a Bachelor's degree in law with four years' experience as a legal practitioner or four years handling legal work in a government department, PSU, autonomous or statutory body. Legal Assistant (Level 6, 5 posts): analogous post, or three years' regular service in Level 6 after regular appointment; and a degree in law. Service condition: analogous post,

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: each post carries the pay matrix level shown in the vacancy table. Pay, allowances and other terms of deputation are regulated by DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended, which governs pay fixation and deputation (duty) allowance for officers on deputation. Tenure: one year, extendable up to three years. Deputation including any immediately preceding ex-cadre post should not ordinarily exceed three years in total. Withdrawal: candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later.

faq.question: Q1. What is DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DPCC Recruitment 2026 is a rolling advertisement by the Delhi Pollution Control Committee to fill 59 vacancies on a deputation basis across various technical, scientific, and legal posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 59 tentative vacancies available across 12 different posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications are received in phases: Phase 1 closes on 31 October 2026, Phase 2 upto 15 November 2026, and Phase 3 upto 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for DPCC posts?
faq.answer: Eligible officers and officials working on a regular basis in Central or State Governments, Union Territories, Recognized Research Institutes, Autonomous bodies, Statutory Bodies, or PSUs are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for DPCC recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for deputation shall be 56 years on the last date of receipt of applications.
